title: PAR-138 typed same-version DXF view-style field overlay
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Serialize edits to modeled DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle fields into their captured same-version DXF records while retaining unmodeled groups and the existing graph/reference gates.

changes.writerShape: The adapter copies the captured raw style record, overlays recognized existing groups using the current parseCode subclass/group/occurrence mappings, and sends the copy through writeRawDxfObject so existing handle remapping and version validation remain active.
changes.rawPreservation: Unchanged ASCII raw lexemes are retained. Changed mapped values update only their corresponding copied raw lexeme. Unknown groups remain ordered and unchanged. Binary output serializes the typed variants.
failClosedCases: typed field changed from class default but no matching source group exists
malformed group value type or non-finite double for a mapped field
SectionViewStyle hatch-angle vector cardinality differs from captured angle groups or count marker
style raw identity, owner, or accepted object name does not match the typed record
positiveControls: ASCII DXF typed DetailViewStyle description, identifier height, and label-pattern edits survive same-version readback
ASCII DXF typed SectionViewStyle hatch-scale, hatch-pattern, and hatch-angle edits survive same-version readback
Binary DXF equivalents survive same-version readback
full ordered raw-group stream remains equal to expected output after handle normalization
negativeControls: adding a third SectionViewStyle hatch angle when the captured graph contains two refuses publication
editing a DetailViewStyle label pattern absent from its source groups refuses publication
both failures preserve a pre-existing output sentinel
changes.worktreeNote: The checkout is broadly dirty and .git is read-only in this session. This slice remains uncommitted; unrelated pre-existing changes were preserved.

focusedSelector.expectedMalformedInputDiagnostics: The selector prints DXF format errors for intentionally malformed graph controls and exits successfully after confirming refusal behavior.

evidenceLimit: This proves generated same-version ASCII/Binary DXF serialization for modeled fields represented by existing groups, preservation of opaque groups, and fail-closed behavior for the tested cardinality/absent-field cases. It does not prove DWG-origin style output, cross-version translation, normative flag/unnamed-field meanings, native rendering, or consumer support.

remainingPAR138Work: DWG-origin style-name and field decoding with producer/spec-backed mapping
insert and reorder source-missing typed fields instead of the current fail-closed rule
cross-version translation and version-specific style gates
normative semantics for DetailViewStyle flags and unnamed SectionViewStyle booleans
